name: Khami Ruins National Monument
description: Khami Ruins lies about 22 kilometres west of Bulawayo in Zimbabwe. It was the capital of the Torwa dynasty's Kingdom of Butua, and it grew after Great Zimbabwe was abandoned in the mid-16th century. Visitors can wander the ruined stone-walled settlement. Finds of European and Chinese objects show it was a busy trading centre for a long time.
